retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-angle facial portrait with a cool blue background and heavy, right-aligned sans-serif display type.
excludeWhen: bright or warm color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a weathered male face, shot from a low angle against a deep blue twilight sky, featuring bold white sans-serif typography tucked into the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The low-angle perspective emphasizes the subject's chin and jawline against the sky.
The cool blue background provides a stark contrast to the warm, textured skin tones.
The right-aligned text block follows the curve of the subject's head.
Deep shadows in the eye sockets and facial creases create a sense of gravitas.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies approximately 70% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the deep shadow of the brow ridge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the textured face to the jaw, then up to the bold text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left and lower right corners, primarily consisting of the blue sky.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white text and dark shadows; low saturation in the skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blues, blacks, and natural skin tones

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with minimal stroke contrast

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in negative space of sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast within the same sans-serif family.
graphicDevices: Small logo/catalog number block in top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rugged, classic American feel of the display type.
Provides the necessary weight and tight spacing for the display role.
Suitable for the secondary list text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle, extreme close-up portrait of a man with weathered skin and a serious expression. The lighting should be dramatic with deep shadows. The background is a solid, dark twilight blue sky. Leave the top right quadrant clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white, right-aligned sans-serif text in the top right corner. The main title should be in a heavy black weight, with a list of items below it in a medium weight condensed font.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle low, looking up at the face?
Is the background a consistent deep blue?
Is the skin texture highly detailed and rugged?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names or song titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the main facial features.
Check that the blue background is not overly saturated.
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Confirm the typography is solid white without effects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle textured portrait + twilight blue backdrop + right-aligned heavy sans-serif type.
